title: Neuro-Cognitive AI Fingerprinting for Pre-Radiographic Brain Tumor Detection
summary: A multimodal biomarker Transformer framework that correlates Phase-Amplitude Coupling (PAC) with ocular, gait, and vocal signals to detect preclinical neural deviations.
problem: Brain tumors often progress unnoticed until structural mass effect manifests on MRI/CT scans. Early-stage synaptic dysregulation leaves micro-functional traces in EEG neural oscillation coupling and motor patterns that standard diagnostic workflows miss.
impact: Achieved 87.4% classification accuracy across synthetic EEG and multimodal physiological traces; published in IJARSCT (Vol. 6, Issue 17). Demonstrated viability of non-invasive pre-radiographic risk screening.

title: Blind Assist Companion (CRIEYA Edge AI)
summary: Wearable assistive navigation device pairing quantised YOLOv8 inference with Time-of-Flight depth sensors on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with Flask REST microservices.
problem: Visually impaired pedestrians face severe spatial disorientation and obstacle collisions in unstructured, dynamic outdoor environments where cloud latency and heavyweight vision systems are unworkable.
impact: Engineered real-time edge obstacle avoidance pipeline operating at 14+ FPS locally on edge hardware with 120ms latency ceiling and dual auditory/haptic directional cues.

title: Multi-Agent Hospital Appointment Booking System
summary: Stateful agentic healthcare triage system built with LangGraph, LangChain, and Gemini function calling across patient intake, doctor scheduling, and slot confirmation.
problem: Manual hospital scheduling creates patient drop-offs, scheduling conflicts, and physician overload due to rigid intake forms and uncoordinated triage.
impact: Decoupled conversational scheduling into three autonomous cooperating agents with structured state management and deterministic calendar slot booking.

title: AI-Powered Expense Tracker with GUI
summary: Desktop financial forecasting and categorisation suite powered by RandomForestRegressor, SQLite3, and Tkinter analytics visualisations.
problem: Personal budgeting tools either require tedious manual tagging or lack predictive forecasting of end-of-month cashflow risk.
impact: Awarded registered Government Copyright (Certificate No. LD-20250172223). Automated spending forecasting with 91.2% regression correlation.

title: Image Captioning and Semantic Segmentation Pipeline
summary: Dual vision-language pipeline integrating U-Net semantic segmentation masks and Mask R-CNN instance boundaries with Transformer caption generation on MS COCO.
problem: Vision models often decouple pixel-level segmentation from natural language narration, requiring disparate architectures and manual synchronization.
impact: Delivered working vision-language system achieving robust mIoU across 20 Pascal VOC classes and BLEU-4 score of 34.2 on MS COCO test splits.

title: Smart Student Assist (Smart India Hackathon 2025)
summary: National hackathon team lead solution providing predictive student retention scoring, curriculum difficulty forecasting, and intelligent study companion tooling.
problem: Educational institutions struggle to identify at-risk students before mid-term dropout inflection points, relying on lagging exam grades.
impact: Led team of 6 engineers to top ranking at SIH 2025; integrated real-time student engagement analytics with automated intervention alerts.

title: Semiconductor Wafer Defect Classifier
summary: Silicon wafer fabrication spatial defect pattern recognition using tree-based XGBoost models and interactive Streamlit defect maps.
problem: High-volume semiconductor manufacturing yields depend on immediate localization of cluster, ring, and scratch defect geometries.
impact: Built rapid defect classification dashboard inspired by semiconductor training at CeNSE, IISc Bangalore.

title: Five Foundational AI Systems (CodSoft)
summary: Comprehensive suite of 5 algorithmic AI systems including Minimax Game Trees, Rule & Semantic Chatbot, Facial Landmark Detection, and Recommender Systems.
problem: Mastering fundamental heuristic search, recommendation collaborative filtering, and facial landmark geometric pipelines.
impact: Completed intensive 30-day accelerated engineering cycle with 100% project sign-off and unit test verification.
